_comment: One connected Training tree per school, written by tools/skills/gen_skill_trees.js from SpineTree in js/plugins/CharacterCreation/SkillMaster.js; do not edit by hand. Spine nodes (spine: true) run down the middle from the school's simplest, cheapest skill; every other plain skill hangs off the rung of its price band on a short side branch; <Esoteric> workings are side leaves the main climb never needs; <Forbidden> ones continue the spine past its last rung. `row` is where a node is drawn, `tier` (0..5) its band for the KP price in SkillMaster.js (KP [60,120,220,380,600,900], x2 Esoteric, x10 Forbidden). Each node names the node it grows out of.
